name: awesome-skills
description: Agent Skills by @kryptobaseddev, plus the plugins that wrap them. Skills install on their own by copy or symlink; a plugin is only needed where a skill cannot reach — slash commands, subagents, and hooks.

plugins.name: deluxui
plugins.description: UX engineering with a verdict. Adds /ux-audit, /ux-harden, /ux-critique, /ux-create and /ux-init, an independent ux-reviewer subagent, and a PostToolUse hook that checks every UI file as it is written. Wraps the deluxui skill (190-rule contract, 163 checks, release gate).
